subject: The dashboard launch, and a pricing experiment that worked
intro: Two updates this week: what we learned shipping late, and a pricing test worth stealing.

sections.heading: We shipped the dashboard three months late
sections.body: Activation is up 18% since launch. The migration cost was the part we underestimated, not the feature itself.

sections.heading: Usage-based pricing beat the flat tier 2:1
sections.body: We ran a simple A/B test on the add-on pricing page. The usage-based option won by a wide margin.
